# EduCut.ai

> EduCut.ai is an AI training provider for companies, universities and professionals: 212 courses in 18 specialized academies, and a free 3-minute assessment that recommends 3, 5 and 7-course AI learning paths.

- Format: Blended: instructor-led online sessions combined with self-paced personal work
- Course length: 150 courses take 9 hours (6 h online + 3 h personal work) and 62 courses take 12 hours (8 h online + 4 h personal work)
- Levels: Foundation (53), Intermediate (106), Advanced (53)
- Language: English (translation available)
- Certification: Certificate awarded upon completion
- Based in: Switzerland
- Catalogue updated: 2026-09-23
- Contact: contact@educutai.com (general), partners@educutai.com (partnerships), support@educutai.com (platform support)

## Main pages

- [Home](https://educutai.com/): overview of EduCut.ai
- [All academies](https://educutai.com/academies/): the 18 academies, a comparison of similar academies and FAQs
- [AI learning paths](https://educutai.com/ai-learning-paths/): how the free assessment works and what it can recommend
- [Contact](https://educutai.com/contact/): free consultation and catalogue request


## Academies

### AI & data foundations

- [AI Foundations](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-foundations/): 24 courses. Build a rigorous understanding of the core disciplines behind modern AI — from machine learning and deep learning to NLP, computer vision, reasoning, safety and AI systems.
- [Generative AI](https://educutai.com/academies/generative-ai/): 20 courses. Understand how generative AI works and how to use it effectively across professional workflows, from foundation models and multimodal systems to practical business applications.
- [Data Analytics](https://educutai.com/academies/data-analytics/): 18 courses. Strengthen the statistical, mathematical and analytical foundations needed to interpret data, build reliable analyses and support better evidence-based decisions.

### AI strategy & transformation

- [AI Transformation](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-transformation/): 10 courses. Turn AI ambition into enterprise execution — assess readiness, define strategy, prioritize use cases, redesign processes, develop skills, govern risk, measure ROI and scale transformation.
- [AI for Leaders](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-leaders/): 10 courses. Equip leaders to identify valuable AI opportunities, make informed investment decisions, lead adoption, govern risk and build an AI-ready organization.
- [AI Productivity](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-productivity/): 10 courses. Turn AI into a practical productivity layer for daily work — improving communication, documents, meetings, research, spreadsheets, planning and repeatable workflows.

### AI for business functions

- [AI for Marketing](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-marketing/): 10 courses. Apply AI across the marketing lifecycle — from strategy, content and social media to SEO, advertising, customer insight, analytics, personalization and automation.
- [AI for Finance](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-finance/): 10 courses. Use AI to enhance financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, accounting, modeling, risk management, investment analysis and finance-team automation.
- [AI for HR](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-hr/): 10 courses. Apply AI across the employee lifecycle — recruitment, onboarding, learning, performance, engagement, workforce planning, people analytics and responsible HR transformation.
- [AI for Education](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-education/): 10 courses. Integrate AI into teaching and learning — from course design and classroom engagement to personalization, assessment, content creation, research and academic integrity.

### Building with LLMs

- [LLM Engineering](https://educutai.com/academies/llm-engineering/): 10 courses. Move from LLM fundamentals to production systems — covering context engineering, APIs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation, security and LLMOps.
- [RAG Systems](https://educutai.com/academies/rag-systems/): 10 courses. Design reliable knowledge-powered AI systems by mastering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, context engineering, advanced RAG, evaluation, security and RAGOps.
- [AI Agents](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-agents/): 10 courses. Learn how to design AI systems that can plan, use tools, manage memory and state, access knowledge, collaborate with other agents and operate safely in production.
- [AI for Developers](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-for-developers/): 10 courses. Help software teams use AI across the development lifecycle and build AI-powered applications using prompting, APIs, RAG, agents, testing, automation and secure production practices.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://educutai.com/academies/prompt-engineering/): 10 courses. Learn to design reliable prompts for everyday work, data analysis, software development, research, multimodal AI and advanced agentic or RAG-based applications.

### Trustworthy AI

- [AI Governance](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-governance/): 10 courses. Create the organizational controls needed to govern AI at scale — policies, risk assessment, lifecycle governance, compliance, vendor oversight, auditability and enterprise governance programs.
- [Responsible AI](https://educutai.com/academies/responsible-ai/): 10 courses. Build AI that is trustworthy and accountable by addressing ethics, fairness, transparency, privacy, safety, governance, regulation and responsible use of generative and agentic AI.
- [AI Security](https://educutai.com/academies/ai-security/): 10 courses. Protect AI systems across their lifecycle — from threat modeling and prompt injection to RAG and agent security, model supply chains, red teaming, monitoring and incident response.
